title: Dutch Foreign Minister gets a bird's eye view of Latvia's eastern border
summary_full: On 9th September 2026, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, hosted Tom Berendsen, the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands, who was visiting Latvia for the first time.
